904c00b26bb27755.description: About the Role SACO, the Saudi Company for Hardware, is seeking a Creative Copywriter to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. The ideal candidate will possess a strong marketing mindset, a passion for storytelling, and a deep understanding of Saudi culture and the Saudi White Dialect. Role Purpose The Creative Copywriter will be responsible for developing engaging, impactful, and persuasive content across various digital platforms. This role ensures content consistency with the brand's tone of voice while driving audience engagement and customer action. Key Responsibilities Create compelling and conversion-focused copy for marketing campaigns, paid advertisements, SMS, push notifications, and email marketing. Develop creative scripts and storyboards for video platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels, Snapchat, and YouTube, focusing on strong hooks for initial engagement. Write engaging captions, posts, and tweets tailored to each social media platform, incorporating Saudi cultural nuances and natural Saudi White Dialect. Collaborate with design and production teams to brainstorm campaign ideas, creative concepts, taglines, and key visual headlines. Develop clear, engaging, and SEO-friendly product descriptions, landing pages, website banners, and other e-commerce and website content. Ensure all content aligns with brand guidelines, tone of voice, and high standards of Arabic language quality. Stay updated on Saudi market trends, audience behavior, and digital content trends, continuously optimizing content performance. Required Qualifications and Skills Experience in retail or e-commerce is a strong advantage. Demonstrated ability to localize and creatively adapt translated content into natural, engaging Arabic. Good understanding of digital marketing principles, social media platforms, and content trends. Strong creativity, storytelling, research, and communication skills. Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. A strong portfolio showcasing previous work, including campaign concepts, social media content, advertising copy, and video scripts, is mandatory. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

90eba647e7c6b8b3.description: About the Role Arriyadh Roaster Trading Company is seeking a Machine Operation professional to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves operating production machinery and ensuring efficient and safe production processes within a food manufacturing facility, with a specific focus on coffee products. The position requires 0-1 years of experience. Key Duties The Machine Operator will be responsible for the daily operation and maintenance of production equipment, ensuring all processes adhere to established safety and quality standards. This includes preparing machines for operation, monitoring performance, and responding to any issues that may arise during production. Operate production machines and equipment according to approved operating procedures. Prepare and inspect machines before starting production to ensure readiness and safety. Set and adjust machine parameters according to product specifications. Monitor machine performance during production and ensure smooth operation. Stop machines when any malfunction or issue may affect product quality or employee safety. Follow the daily production plan and achieve assigned production targets. Specific Responsibilities This role requires hands-on operation of various machines involved in coffee production and general food packaging. The operator will ensure product quality and adherence to specifications at each stage of the production process. Operate coffee roasting machines according to required roasting profiles, temperatures, and times. Operate coffee grinding machines and adjust grinding settings according to product specifications. Operate filling, sealing, and packaging machines for food and coffee products. Monitor product weight during filling and ensure compliance with approved specifications. Ensure packaging materials are properly sealed and free from defects. Monitor the flow of raw materials through production machines and report any blockages or interruptions. Ensure finished products meet the required specifications before transferring them to the next production stage. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess foundational experience in machine operation within a manufacturing environment, ideally with exposure to food production. A strong understanding of operational safety and quality control is essential. 0-1 years of experience in machine operation. Ability to follow detailed operating procedures and production plans. Attention to detail for monitoring machine performance and product quality. Commitment to safety protocols in a production environment. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, within a food manufacturing facility specializing in coffee products. The role requires active participation in the production line and adherence to all operational guidelines.

902819a7d2c1dc6d.description: About the Role FNRCO is seeking a Network Security Administrator to join their team in Makkah, with locations including Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role involves managing and maintaining a multi-vendor security infrastructure, focusing on the administration, tuning, and lifecycle management of various security platforms. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Summary The Network Security Administrator will ensure the security, stability, and integration of firewalls, application delivery and WAF platforms, DDoS protection, and email security solutions. This position requires hands-on administration and troubleshooting across complex multi-vendor environments. Key Responsibilities Perform end-to-end administration of security platforms, including configuration, policy management, and tuning. Plan and execute patching and upgrades with minimal service disruption. Maintain configuration standards, documentation, and change records. Administer Cisco Firepower and Palo Alto firewalls, managing rule bases, NAT, VPN, and threat prevention policies. Manage F5 platforms, including ASM (WAF), APM (remote access and VPN), and GTM (global DNS load balancing). Administer and tune DDoS mitigation solutions such as Arbor and Akamai. Administer email security gateways like Proofpoint, Symantec, Cisco ESA, and FortiMail, covering filtering policies, anti-spam, anti-phishing, and quarantine management. Diagnose and resolve issues across complex multi-vendor environments, including integration problems. Collaborate with network, infrastructure, and security operations teams to support incidents and projects. Utilize PowerShell or Python to automate routine administration and reporting tasks, as applicable. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in network security administration, with a focus on multi-vendor security infrastructure. Proficiency in managing firewalls, WAF platforms, DDoS protection, and email security solutions is required. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in the Makkah region, with operations in both Jeddah and Makkah. The role involves working within a dynamic team environment, collaborating with various technical departments to maintain robust security operations. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this Network Security Administrator position. Salary details will be disclosed during the interview process.

909ff7d98391558c.description: About the Role Business Enhancers is seeking a Senior Data Engineer for a contract position in Riyadh. This role involves designing, building, and optimizing scalable data pipelines on the Microsoft cloud data stack. The Senior Data Engineer will collaborate with BI, analytics, and business teams to transform raw data from various sources into reliable, well-modeled datasets that support reporting and decision-making across the organization. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain end-to-end data engineering pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, and Azure Databricks. Develop robust ETL/ELT processes for ingesting, transforming, and loading data from diverse sources, including legacy systems. Build and optimize data lakes, lakehouses, and data warehouse models. Ensure data quality, performance, security, and governance across all pipelines. Monitor, troubleshoot, and tune pipelines for reliability and cost efficiency. Collaborate with BI developers and business stakeholders to deliver analytics-ready data. Document data flows and apply engineering best practices, including version control and CI/CD. Required Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 5 years of hands-on data engineering experience. Strong experience with the Microsoft Azure data stack, including Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Microsoft Fabric, and Databricks. Advanced SQL skills and strong proficiency in Python or PySpark. Solid understanding of data modeling concepts, including dimensional, lakehouse, and medallion architectures. Experience with orchestration, performance tuning, and data quality frameworks. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. Language and Communication Skills Strong communication skills are essential. Professional English is required, with Arabic proficiency considered a plus.

90b3b5cde17e39b2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مداره للاستشارات الهندسية عن مهندس إنشائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، بالمنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على تخطيط وتصميم ومراجعة الخطط الإنشائية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال. هذه الفرصة بدوام كامل ومناسبة للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية حساب حجم وشكل ومقاومة ونوع العناصر الإنشائية، أو إجراء تحليل إنشائي للعناصر مسبقة التصميم. تصميم العناصر الإنشائية بناءً على الأحمال المقدرة. تفقد الإنشاءات القائمة والتوصية بإصلاح أو استبدال العناصر الإنشائية المعيبة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الهندسة الإنشائية. القدرة على تحليل الإجهادات وتصميم العناصر الإنشائية. مهارات قوية في إعداد التقارير والوثائق الفنية. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الإنشائي بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مداره للاستشارات الهندسية في مدينة الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب الدور الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق مداره للاستشارات الهندسية، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

9052575d0f1bbafd.description: About Unifonic and the Role Unifonic, a dynamic startup in the CPaaS (Communication Platform as a Service) sector, is seeking an Infrastructure Engineering Manager. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. The successful candidate will lead the engineering and operations of production cloud platforms, integrating Infrastructure Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Cloud Platform Engineering, and AI-native engineering to ensure reliability, scalability, security, performance, and automation. The role requires over 10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Own the architecture, engineering, operation, and continuous improvement of production infrastructure across Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Lead the technical aspects of migrating production workloads to GCP, leveraging strong practical GCP expertise. Design highly available, scalable, resilient, and secure production platforms. Set engineering standards for compute, networking, storage, IAM, and cloud-native services, ensuring consistent patterns across GCP and OCI. Manage production Kubernetes platforms and their supporting ecosystem, focusing on security, observability, scalability, resilience, and automation. Own platform capabilities including ingress, service networking and service mesh, monitoring, and logging. Collaborate with application engineering teams to enhance workload reliability and operational readiness. Build automation and self-service capabilities to reduce manual infrastructure work. Establish and improve SRE practices across production infrastructure, driving reliability through SLIs, SLOs, and operational metrics. Lead infrastructure-level troubleshooting during complex production incidents and champion rigorous root-cause analysis. Drive an Infrastructure-as-Code-first operating model, maintaining discipline around Terraform, reusable modules, and automated validation. Embed AI into daily infrastructure engineering workflows, using tools like Claude Code for code review, problem investigation, and automation. Oversee critical production platform and backing services, including databases, caching, messaging, Kubernetes, networking, IAM, and observability platforms. Build security into infrastructure design, owning IAM, network security, segmentation, secrets management, and infrastructure hardening. Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of Infrastructure and SRE engineers, fostering a culture of engineering ownership. Stay technically credible by guiding architecture, reviewing solutions, and participating in complex troubleshooting. Drive adoption of AI-native engineering and coach engineers on AI-assisted workflows. Technical Focus The role requires hands-on engagement, including reviewing infrastructure code and architecture, troubleshooting complex production issues, and working with Kubernetes and cloud services. A strong focus will be on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), with significant practical GCP expertise essential for the ongoing migration. Daily use of AI engineering tools such as Claude Code is expected. Collaboration and Standards This role involves collaboration with the Infrastructure Engineering Manager – Developer Experience, who manages non-production environments, CI/CD, and developer tooling. The manager will partner with Product Engineering, Security, and other teams on production platform strategy, setting clear engineering standards and maintaining strong documentation and knowledge sharing. Required Experience Over 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Benefits Unifonic offers a range of benefits, including a competitive salary and bonus, a Unifonic share scheme, 30 holiday days after the first anniversary, your birthday off, up to 25 days per year for remote work from anywhere in the world, and paid leave for new parents.

90979760b3a13f5d.description: نبحث عن سيده لبقة، منظمة ومبادرة، لديها القدرة على خدمة العملاء، وتنظيم الحجوزات والفعاليات، ومتابعة فريق العمل وإدارة العمليات اليومية للاستديو. المتطلبات: شهادة ثانوية عامة أو دبلوم. إجادة الحاسب الآلي واللغة الإنجليزية. مهارات إدارية وتنظيمية. حسن التعامل مع العملاء. الالتزام بمواعيد العمل وتحمل المسؤولية. تفاصيل الوظيفة: الموقع: الرياض – حي حطين. الدوام: 1 ظهرًا – 10 مساءً. الإجازة الأسبوعية: الجمعة. الراتب : 3,000 ريال شهريًا .

90d8cf2bac68c6b8.description: About the EMD Cogen Project Role Aljomaih Energy and Water Company is seeking an experienced professional for the EMD Cogen Project in Al Jubayl, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 5-10 years of experience. The project is a brownfield independent steam and power plant (ISPP) with a capacity for 400MW-450MW of combined-cycle electricity generation and 550-700 tonnes per hour of steam. It will include Mitsubishi gas turbines, Nooter Eriksen HRSG, a back-pressure steam turbine, and steam production facilities. This role offers engagement across the full project lifecycle, from design and engineering to construction and operation. Key Responsibilities Manage the Company, including employee recruitment, procedures, and facilities, in agreement with the Board of Directors and the long-term business plan. Represent the Company and manage relations with authorities, regulatory agencies, lenders, banks, and professional organizations. Oversee the proper execution of Health and Safety protocols and commercial/financial contracts, coordinating with the Board of Directors to resolve issues. Manage topics related to the EPC contractor. Ensure necessary permits and consents are obtained and maintained. Keep the Company informed of applicable changes in law and regulations. Promote a safe and environmentally friendly company culture. Manage the P&L and cashflow of the entity, as well as budgets and business plans. Periodically review plan status and risks, develop plans for major issues, and seek Board approval. Envisage, seek approval for, and implement necessary steps for a mid- to long-term business/operating plan for the plant. Accountabilities Conduct and coordinate high-level interfaces with key stakeholders including shareholders, authorities, banks, and clients. During construction, ensure adherence to Good Health and Safety, Engineering and Construction Practices, and best practices for Project Management according to AEW's guidelines. Prepare medium and long-term budget forecasts, monitoring and reporting variances. Foster good industrial relations at the site and with local groups and communities. Ensure preparedness for emergency incidents and coordinate with mutual aid partners. Verify insurance coverage and policies are in place, claims procedures are followed, and no actions void policies. Set team objectives, evaluate personnel, and establish salary/benefits policies and incentive schemes approved by the Board. Report the Company's health to the Board of Directors and shareholder companies as required. Submit the annual operating budget for Board approval and ensure operation within approved limits. Approve subordinate expenses in accordance with established policies. Manage Human Resources for the Company. Foster good working relations with the site operator. Deal with disputes, taking responsibility and coordinating with committees as pertinent. Ensure lender covenants and other requirements are met, and manage refinancing in accordance with Board/Shareholder guidance. Ensure correct implementation of the Ethical Charter, application of best practices set by Shareholders, and correct governance. Ensure compliance with relevant Stock Market requirements for listed companies. Health, Safety, and Environment Ensure an effective HSE strategy is in place, complying with applicable legislation and AEW standards. Ensure sufficient resources are assigned for HSE activities and appropriate supervision is in place. Promote a strong safety culture, ensuring stakeholder HSE management aligns with AEW's vision. Support the Project Company's Construction Manager / Project Director in their HSE roles. Attend periodic HSE performance review meetings. Demonstrate leadership commitment through visibility and actions. Key Relationships This role involves extensive internal and external interfaces. Internal relationships include company directors and shareholder-designated focal points (legal, financial, tax, internal audit), as well as company staff. External interfaces encompass the off-taker, Sdara Host plant, EPC and O&M Contractors, Owner's Engineers, insurers/brokers/loss adjusters, various external advisors (environmental, legal), government entities, banks/lenders' advisors, and OEMs. The role also involves interaction with directors and shareholders of any seconded companies. Project Duration The anticipated duration for this project role is to 3 years.

90f868181d00990f.description: About Accor Accor fosters a diverse and inclusive workplace, valuing each team member's contribution. The company is committed to business ethics, responsible tourism, sustainable development, community outreach, and diversity and inclusion. With a portfolio of hotels and brands, Accor offers opportunities for career advancement and professional development globally. The Role of Finance Manager Accor is seeking a Finance Manager for a full-time position in Al Madinah, with locations including Yanbu and Medina. This senior role offers scope for impact and growth. The Finance Manager will ensure timely and accurate financial management reports, adhering to country tax regulations, corporate office requirements, and owner specifications. The role involves establishing proper internal controls and leading the development of accounting staff through training and cross-training to meet the hotel’s people and culture needs. Candidates should have 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Ensure all accounting colleagues understand and adhere to company accounting policies and procedures, especially those related to country tax rules and regulations. Monitor daily routines within the accounting department to ensure effective, efficient, and tax-compliant work practices. Supervise and assist with account reconciliations, account analysis, and month-end closing procedures. Verify the accuracy of night audit transactions in terms of applicable tax rules and monitor adherence to established procedures for all hotel department purchases or sales. Oversee the filing and maintenance of all tax accounting-related documents and records in accordance with country document retention regulations and the Hotel Management Agreement. Ensure the accuracy and timeliness of all operational financial reporting to both FRHI and the Owner. Plan, educate, and audit departmental and hotel staff involved in ordering goods or signing tax-related documents. Oversee training, cross-training, and development of hotel staff on local taxation issues. Perform related tasks such as leading forecasting, reporting, budgeting, internal control, and completing account analysis. Prepare all financial statements, accruals, and journal entries, and maintain reconciliations for all balance sheet accounts related to taxation, in established corporate formats and according to generally accepted accounting principles. Supervise and ensure all reports and documents comply with IFRS, the latest edition of the Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry, and Hotel Management Agreement requirements. Maintain thorough knowledge of all tax-related documents and laws in the country and follow up on all changes. Lead the preparation of all budgets and forecasts. Supervise the day-to-day activities of Accounting staff, providing assistance as needed. Prepare or oversee the preparation of all local, state, and other tax filings, returns, and reporting on a timely basis, to the extent of the operating company’s responsibility. Participate in and develop staff training programs to minimize colleague turnover and ensure effective accounting office operations. Conduct oneself professionally at all times to reflect brand standards and encourage staff to do the same. Required Qualifications Thorough knowledge of all jobs within the Accounting areas. Commitment to following all local and corporate policies and procedures. High degree of professional integrity and confidentiality. Ability to work in a safe, prudent, and organized manner.

9037d06ae9abe9f3.description: About Qiddiya Investment Company Qiddiya Investment Company is a Saudi developer and investment holding company focused on large-scale entertainment, sports, and culture destinations, including the Qiddiya mega-project. The company operates at the forefront of the real estate sector, developing ambitious destinations through complex, high-impact initiatives. Role Overview As a Senior Manager - Development, you will be instrumental in driving major development initiatives from early planning stages through to execution. This full-time role involves shaping decisions that influence project direction, delivery strategy, and overall development outcomes. You will work closely with internal stakeholders and external partners throughout the project lifecycle, contributing to landmark projects that integrate long-term vision, rigorous planning, and coordinated delivery across multiple disciplines. Key Responsibilities Lead the end-to-end planning and execution of large-scale development projects. Manage project budgets, schedules, and risks, ensuring cross-functional stakeholder alignment. Coordinate architects, engineers, consultants, and contractors to achieve delivery milestones. Conduct feasibility studies and market assessments to inform development decisions. Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, quality standards, and project governance. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in development or a related field. The role requires a proven track record in managing complex projects and coordinating diverse teams. Work Type This is a full-time position within Qiddiya Investment Company. Application Process Further details regarding the application process will be provided to qualified candidates.

9059a442600f263c.description: About the Role Siemens Energy is seeking a Senior Mechanical Supervisor for DR Legacy fleet to join their team in Dammam, Eastern region. This full-time role involves overseeing all technical aspects of the company's control systems and managing the scope of work during equipment installation and overhaul during service outages. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Perform mechanical installation and overhaul of industrial steam turbines (IST) and related equipment according to OEM quality standards. Supervise and direct a team in performing complete overhaul and installation of steam turbines as per service requirements. Verify OEM installation instructions and readings, including baseplate levelness and alignment. Interpret P&ID and dimensional drawings. Conduct Root Cause Analysis when necessary. Perform complex repairs on machinery and ancillary systems, articulating findings to engineering for issue resolution. Communicate progress, schedule updates, and recommend spare parts to clients, and prepare detailed technical reports. About the Team The Transformation of Industry division focuses on decarbonizing the industrial sector. This involves increasing electrification and efficiency, alongside addressing the rising demand for green H2 and derivative fuels. The team supports the decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, leveraging a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities. About Siemens Energy Siemens Energy is an energy technology company with approximately 100,000 employees across more than 90 countries. The company develops energy systems for the future, aiming to meet the global community's growing energy demand reliably and sustainably. Technologies developed in their research departments and factories contribute to the energy transition and account for one-sixth of the world's electricity generation. The global team is committed to achieving sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy, building on a 150-year legacy of innovation focused on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Commitment to Diversity Siemens Energy values diversity, recognizing that it generates strength and fosters inclusion. The company's combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates individual character, without discrimination based on ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability, aiming to energize all of society.

905fcd6726bc9ab2.description: About the Role Taj HR is seeking an experienced and commercially driven Business Development & Product Strategy Manager with a strong background in the food manufacturing industry. This full-time role focuses on identifying, evaluating, and developing new business opportunities, expanding the company's product portfolio, and driving sustainable business growth. The successful candidate will combine knowledge of food manufacturing processes with commercial and strategic expertise to identify market opportunities and translate them into profitable initiatives, reporting directly to the CEO. Key Responsibilities Identify and evaluate new business opportunities within the food manufacturing sector. Develop strategies for business diversification, market expansion, and entry into new product categories. Assess the existing product portfolio for improvement, expansion, repositioning, or discontinuation. Lead the evaluation and commercialization of new product concepts in collaboration with R&D, Production, Sales, and Marketing teams. Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and industry assessments to identify emerging trends. Prepare comprehensive business cases and feasibility studies for new products, production lines, and potential business investments. Evaluate technical and commercial feasibility, including manufacturing capabilities, raw material availability, and operational costs. Present well-supported business proposals and strategic recommendations to executive management. Coordinate approved product development and business expansion projects from evaluation through commercialization. Monitor project progress, commercial performance, and profitability. Expected Deliverables The role requires the provision of strategic assessments and actionable plans to support company growth. Key deliverables include: Strategic assessments of the existing product portfolio. Proposals for new food products and product categories. Feasibility studies for new manufacturing activities and production lines. Market research and competitor assessments. Business diversification and market expansion proposals. Financial and commercial evaluations of proposed initiatives. Measurable progress reports on approved development projects. Qualifications and Experience Proven experience in business development and product strategy within the food manufacturing industry. A minimum of 5-10 years of relevant experience is required. Strong knowledge of food manufacturing processes. Demonstrated commercial and strategic expertise. Ability to conduct product costing, pricing analysis, profitability assessments, and ROI calculations. Required Skills Independent and analytical thinking. Commercially minded approach to business development. Strong ability to develop actionable recommendations. Excellent cross-functional collaboration and project implementation skills. Ability to build and maintain strategic relationships with industry partners. Work Environment This role involves close collaboration with internal departments including R&D, Production, Sales, Marketing, Procurement, and Finance. The position requires an independent professional capable of leading strategic development initiatives from initial assessment through implementation.

90661b7bd5d7b5e8.description: About the Role Basic Chemical Industries Group is seeking a General Ledger Team Leader to join their team in Al Khobar. This full-time role involves leading and supervising the General Ledger (GL) team, ensuring accurate accounting records and timely financial reporting for the company. Key Responsibilities Lead and supervise the GL team, ensuring accurate accounting records and timely financial reporting. Coordinate and oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual closing activities. Review and post GL journal entries, reconciliations, and accounting adjustments in accordance with approved authorities and internal controls. Review monthly GL reconciliations with Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Inventory, and Fixed Assets. Prepare and review standalone and consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS. Prepare quarterly and annual financial statements for external audit purposes, coordinate with internal and external auditors, and ensure timely completion of all audit requirements. Oversee intercompany reconciliations, eliminations, and financial reporting adjustments. Review VAT and WHT reconciliations and ensure compliance with ZATCA requirements. Review GL mappings and financial statement classifications. Strengthen SAP controls, improve accounting processes, and monitor GL team performance. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in general ledger management and financial reporting. The role requires a strong understanding of accounting principles and financial regulations. Technical Skills Proficiency in SAP for financial controls and accounting processes. Strong knowledge of IFRS for financial statement preparation. Familiarity with ZATCA requirements for VAT and WHT compliance. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Khobar. The General Ledger Team Leader will work within a dedicated finance team, collaborating with various departments and external auditors. Application Process The salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

9072bbce0f1aa063.description: About the Role HanmiGlobal Saudi is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer to join its program management and PMCM team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves providing program-level electrical engineering expertise and technical governance for a mega multi-work package land and infrastructure development program, delivered on behalf of a major government entity. Role Overview The Senior Electrical Engineer will deliver program-level technical expertise, engineering assurance, and collaborative oversight. This includes reviewing and monitoring all electrical designs across the program, ensuring power distribution systems, substations, electrical utility networks, and street lighting systems are fully integrated and compliant with approved design standards, utility requirements, statutory regulations, and operational needs. The role reports directly to the Technical Manager and supports the successful delivery of the overall development program. Key Responsibilities Review and assess electrical engineering reports, design calculations, load studies, specifications, drawings, power demand analyses, and technical submissions for compliance with approved standards, utility requirements, client requirements, and project objectives. Evaluate electrical engineering solutions for safety, reliability, resilience, operability, maintainability, energy efficiency, sustainability, and lifecycle performance. Review power distribution systems, medium- and low-voltage networks, substations, electrical utility corridors, street lighting systems, and associated electrical infrastructure. Assess electrical load forecasts, network capacities, utility interface requirements, and power supply strategies, ensuring effective integration with transportation, telecommunications, utilities, facilities, and other infrastructure systems. Coordinate with utility providers and regulatory authorities to support approvals, technical compliance, and infrastructure integration. Support engineering governance by reviewing technical compliance, engineering deviations, design modifications, and Value Engineering proposals. Assess the impact of design changes on safety, reliability, operational efficiency, sustainability, cost, schedule, maintainability, and lifecycle performance. Provide technical recommendations to support informed engineering decisions and effective risk mitigation throughout the program lifecycle. Coordinate with Lead Developers, consultants, contractors, utility providers, government authorities, and regulatory agencies on electrical engineering matters, approvals, and technical compliance. Prepare technical assessments, engineering review comments, executive summaries, and recommendations for the Technical Manager, PMCM Management, and the Client. Participate in multidisciplinary design reviews, technical workshops, coordination meetings, and stakeholder engagement sessions, promoting engineering excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university. Chartered Professional membership or equivalent professional accreditation. Minimum of fifteen (15) years of professional experience in electrical infrastructure, power distribution systems, utility networks, urban development, infrastructure delivery, or major capital projects. Experience within PMCM, PMC, consultancy, developer, contractor, utility organizations, or client-side organizations, preferably on major infrastructure and land development programs in Saudi Arabia or the GCC. Reporting Structure This position reports directly to the Technical Manager.

90771d0aa1b3401f.description: About Horizontal Digital Horizontal Digital is a digital consultancy focused on creating intuitive and empathetic digital experiences. The company aims to solve customer needs for ambitious organizations by integrating strategy, data, design, and technology to deliver results. Role Overview Horizontal Digital is seeking a Salesforce Functional Lead to be based in Saudi Arabia, specifically in Riyadh or Jeddah. This full-time role involves shaping and leading the functional design of a large-scale Salesforce program for a major enterprise client within the Kingdom. 902f3e0aaf60f5fc.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة الخبراء المحترفون لأعمال التكييف عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تعزيز المبيعات وبناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء، ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال المبيعات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمحتملين، تتضمن بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء وزيارتهم لتقديم المنتجات والخدمات، وعرض مواصفاتها وميزاتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار المعتمدة ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المحددة، وإتمام عمليات البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. متابعة وتحصيل ديون العملاء، وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، ثم توريدها إلى الدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات. القدرة على بناء علاقات مهنية قوية مع العملاء. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مؤسسة الخبراء المحترفون لأعمال التكييف في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتم العمل في بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

90a671489b57c1c6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة فيوتشر آسبيريشنز عن بائع للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور على بيع مجموعة متنوعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء، وتوفير معلومات شاملة حول المنتجات، بالإضافة إلى إدارة عمليات الدفع والمخزون. هذه فرصة بدوام كامل تتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع مجموعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء، مع التركيز على تلبية احتياجاتهم. توفير معلومات دقيقة ومفصلة للعملاء حول المنتجات، بما في ذلك استخداماتها وميزاتها وأسعارها. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بشكل دوري لضمان توفر المنتجات، والحفاظ على ترتيب المتجر ونظافته. إصدار طلبات شراء المنتجات الجديدة عند الحاجة، والتعامل مع المنتجات الواردة وتخزينها بشكل صحيح. تولي أمور الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من العملاء بكفاءة ودقة. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات وفقاً لسياسات الشركة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع العملاء وتقديم خدمة ممتازة. مهارات تواصل جيدة ولباقة في التعامل. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة. سيعمل البائع ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي لدعم أهداف الشركة في خدمة العملاء والمبيعات. طبيعة العمل يتضمن الدور التعامل المباشر مع العملاء وإدارة عمليات البيع اليومية، بالإضافة إلى المهام المتعلقة بالمخزون وترتيب المتجر لضمان تجربة تسوق سلسة وممتعة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة فيوتشر آسبيريشنز.

9046c61a7d3274c1.description: نبحث عن اخصائي نمو تجارة الكترونية المهام والمسؤوليات تحليل المتجر أسبوعياً: مبيعات كل منتج، قمع التحويل، السلات المتروكة ومصادر الزيارات، وتقديم تقرير كل خميس بما تغيّر وما القرار المطلوب. تحسين معدل التحويل: تطوير صفحات المنتجات والبكجات والصفحة الرئيسية وصفحات الهبوط، واختبار العناوين والصور والعروض. التسعير والعروض: بناء سلّم البكجات، تصميم عروض البيع المتقاطع، وإدارة تقويم العروض الموسمية (رمضان، اليوم الوطني، الجمعة البيضاء، الرواتب). الاحتفاظ بالعملاء: أتمتة رسائل السلات المتروكة، حملات واتساب والرسائل النصية لقاعدة العملاء، تذكير إعادة الطلب، وجمع التقييمات ومتابعة السلبي منها. توجيه الإعلانات بالأرقام: العمل مع مسؤول الحملات على تحديد الحملات التي تُكبَّر والتي تُوقف، بناءً على التحويل والعائد على الإنفاق. توجيه المحتوى: تسليم فريق المحتوى والمصمم موجزاً أسبوعياً يحدد المنتج والزاوية والعرض المطلوب دعمه. ربط المخزون بالمبيعات: التنبيه قبل نفاد أي منتج عليه حملة أو عرض. دقة بيانات المتجر: مراجعة التكاليف والأسعار والأوصاف، وإيقاف العروض المنتهية في وقتها. الالتزام بصياغة العلامة: منتجاتنا تجميلية، وكل نص في المتجر والرسائل يخلو من الادعاءات الطبية. المؤهلات والمهارات أساسية خبرة لا تقل عن سنتين إلى أربع سنوات و اكثر في إدارة أو تنمية متجر إلكتروني، ويفضّل على سلة أو زد. إتقان مؤشرات التجارة الإلكترونية: معدل التحويل، متوسط قيمة الطلب، تكلفة الاستحواذ، العائد على الإنفاق الإعلاني، ونسبة إعادة الشراء. مستوى جيد في إكسل أو Google Sheets (جداول محورية ومعادلات). فهم عملي لإعلانات تيك توك وميتا يكفي لقراءة تقاريرها ومناقشتها. خبرة في تسويق الاحتفاظ: واتساب، الرسائل النصية، وأتمتة السلات المتروكة. كتابة عربية واضحة لصفحات المنتجات والرسائل التسويقية. مرجّحة خبرة سابقة في منتجات التجميل أو العناية أو المنتجات الاستهلاكية. Google Analytics 4 و TikTok Pixel. تجربة في اختبارات A/B لصفحات المنتجات أو الهبوط. معرفة بضوابط الادعاءات التسويقية لمنتجات التجميل في السعودية. السمات الشخصية يبادر بالتوصية ولا ينتظر التكليف. دقيق في الأرقام ويفرّق بين ما تثبته البيانات وما هو استنتاج. يعمل مع المصمم والكاتب ومسؤول الحملات ويوجّههم دون أن يكون مديرهم.

909ceb59ba51ade4.job_title: Senior Director - Waste Management - City 190- AA7
909ceb59ba51ade4.description: Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Senior Director – Waste Management to lead the strategy, infrastructure and service framework supporting Qiddiya City as it opens and grows. Bringing together entertainment, sports and culture, the city offers an opportunity to establish waste management services that support resource recovery, operational resilience and long-term value. What you’ll lead: Strategy and operating model: Develop and deliver the city-wide waste strategy, policies and implementation roadmap, defining responsibilities, service interfaces and governance across stakeholders. Asset ownership and lifecycle planning: Set requirements for waste infrastructure, facilities, fleet and equipment, overseeing maintenance standards, asset condition, renewal priorities and whole-life value. Investment and commercial governance: Lead capital and operating budgets, demand forecasts and business cases; shape procurement strategies and govern major contracts and operator performance. Capacity and operational readiness: Align infrastructure and service capacity with city growth, reviewing designs and assuring commissioning, handover and asset acceptance readiness. Waste prevention and resource recovery: Develop programmes for reuse, segregation, recycling and recovery, working with sustainability teams and asset operators to reduce contamination and identify viable material outlets. Compliance and resilience: Lead environmental and safety assurance, risk management, waste traceability and business continuity, with clear arrangements for specialist waste interfaces. Performance and insight: Establish verified reporting on waste volumes, recovery, disposal, service quality, asset availability and unit costs to guide improvement and investment. Functional leadership: Build and develop the waste management function, establishing the structure, capabilities and accountability needed to deliver the approved operating model. What you’ll bring A bachelor’s degree in Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering, Environmental Science, Waste Management or a related discipline . At least 15 years of relevant experience in waste management, environmental infrastructure or integrated municipal services, including 7 years in senior leadership roles with strategic, asset and commercial accountability. Demonstrated experience developing and implementing city-scale or large mixed-use waste strategies and owning or governing waste infrastructure portfolios. A strong track record overseeing outsourced operators and major contracts, managing budgets and lifecycle investment, and supporting design review, commissioning and operational mobilisation. Experience spanning segregation, collection logistics, transfer, recycling and recovery, regulatory interfaces and phased developments. Strong capabilities in strategic planning, asset lifecycle management, demand and capacity modelling, procurement, commercial governance and data-led performance management. Executive communication, negotiation and cross-functional leadership skills.

Working closely with clients to understand their requirements and objectives. Collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure successful implementation and delivery of integration solutions. Identifying and resolving any issues or bugs in the integration solutions. Staying up-to-date with the latest IBM integration technologies and best practices. Strong Experience in working with various data formats and transformation techniques such as XSLT and/or GatewayScript. 9018d71a7ca75749.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة التكامل الوطنية للزراعة عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تنفيذ ومتابعة الأعمال المحاسبية والمالية، وضمان دقة تسجيل العمليات المالية والتقارير والحسابات الختامية. سيقوم شاغل الوظيفة بمراقبة النفقات والإيرادات والتكاليف بما يتوافق مع السياسات والإجراءات والمعايير المحاسبية المعتمدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط والمتطلبات النظامية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تدقيقها واعتمادها وفق الصلاحيات والإجراءات المعتمدة. مراقبة النفقات التشغيلية والرأسمالية ومتابعة تنفيذ بنود الموازنة وتحليل الانحرافات. إعداد الموقف المالي والتقارير والخلاصات المالية الشهرية والحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل ومراجعة العمليات المالية في السجلات والأنظمة المحاسبية. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات البنكية ومطابقتها بشكل دوري. متابعة الإيرادات والمصروفات والمستحقات والتأكد من صحة أرصدتها. متابعة حسابات المخزون وحركته وتقييمه ومطابقة الأرصدة. متابعة توزيع التكاليف على مراكز التكلفة وتحليل التكاليف والانحرافات بين الفعلي والمقدر. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المالية والمحاسبية المتخصصة وحفظها وتنظيمها في قواعد البيانات. تطوير الإجراءات والأساليب المحاسبية ومواكبة التطورات التقنية والمهنية في مجال المحاسبة. الالتزام بالمعايير المحاسبية والأنظمة الزكوية والضريبية واللوائح ذات العلاقة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال المحاسبة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل المحاسب ضمن فريق مالي لدعم العمليات المحاسبية للشركة.

90cc48018b6d808e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تقنيات القمم عن فني شبكات للانضمام إلى فريقها في مدينة حائل. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب وتشغيل وصيانة شبكات الحاسب الآلي ومكوناتها، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال الفنية ومعالجتها. يهدف الدور إلى ضمان استمرارية الاتصال وتقديم الدعم الفني اللازم للمستخدمين. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تلحيم كابلات الألياف الضوئية (Fiber) وتنفيذ أعمال التمديد والفحص والاختبار لضمان جودة التوصيلات. تركيب وتشغيل وصيانة شبكات الحاسب الآلي وأجهزة الشبكات المختلفة. تمديد وتوصيل كابلات الشبكات وتركيب نقاط الاتصال وفقاً للمعايير المعتمدة. تشخيص أعطال الشبكات ومعالجتها بفعالية لضمان استمرارية الاتصال. إعداد وتهيئة أجهزة الشبكات، بما في ذلك أجهزة التوجيه (Routers) والمحولات (Switches). تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الوقائية والدورية لمكونات الشبكة للحفاظ على أدائها. مراقبة أداء الشبكات واكتشاف المشكلات الفنية والعمل على حلها بشكل استباقي. تقديم الدعم الفني اليومي للشبكات والمستخدمين ومعالجة مشكلات الاتصال. توثيق أعمال الصيانة والأعطال والإجراءات المتخذة بشكل دقيق. الالتزام بمعايير أمن الشبكات والسلامة والإجراءات الفنية المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين ثلاث إلى خمس سنوات في مجال فني الشبكات. معرفة قوية بتركيب وتشغيل وصيانة شبكات الحاسب الآلي. القدرة على تلحيم كابلات الألياف الضوئية (Fiber) وتنفيذ أعمال الفحص والاختبار. مهارات تشخيص الأعطال الفنية ومعالجتها. القدرة على إعداد وتهيئة أجهزة الشبكات مثل أجهزة التوجيه والمحولات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة حائل. يعمل فني الشبكات ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان استمرارية وكفاءة البنية التحتية للشبكات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال مراحل المقابلة.

9008c4b9e7230863.job_title: Manager Operational Readiness Planning and Reporting
9008c4b9e7230863.company_name: Qiddiya Investment Company | شركة قدية الاستثمارية
9008c4b9e7230863.description: About Qiddiya Investment Company Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Manager for Operational Readiness Planning and Reporting DA. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires an experienced professional to integrate program delivery views for decision-making. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to establish a unified, decision-ready view of program delivery. This involves integrating Primavera P6 schedules with automated Power BI analytics and executive PowerPoint reporting. The successful candidate will combine hands-on Primavera P6 capability with a strong consulting mindset to manage complex schedules and provide concise reports to senior leadership. Key Responsibilities Primavera P6 Schedule Establishment & Control: Develop and maintain integrated master schedules across projects, operational readiness workstreams, and key interfaces. Establish enterprise project structures, WBS, activity coding, calendars, logic, milestones, constraints, and baselines. Integrate various project phases including construction, testing, commissioning, handover, operator mobilization, and Day 1 readiness activities. Validate schedule quality, run update cycles, perform variance analysis, forecasting, scenario modeling, and recovery planning. Implement controls for schedule ownership, change management, data cut-off, status dates, approvals, and baseline governance. Power BI Schedule Analytics: Design and implement Power BI data models and dashboards using Primavera P6 exports and approved project data. Automate reporting for progress, milestones, critical path, float, variance, slippage, look-ahead, risks, and dependencies. Develop drill-down views from portfolio to activity level and ensure data alignment with the approved P6 schedule through clear definitions and reconciliation controls. Executive PowerPoint Reporting: Produce concise, consulting-quality PowerPoint presentations for leadership forums, steering committees, and executive reviews. Translate schedule data into clear messages on performance, critical decisions, key risks, interdependencies, and required interventions. Develop standard reporting pages such as executive summary, milestone outlook, critical path, look-back/look-ahead, trend analysis, decision log, and recovery plans, ensuring clear storylines and evidence-based conclusions. Generic Responsibilities: Lead planning workshops with project teams and stakeholders to establish credible plans. Challenge assumptions and identify gaps between delivery completion and operational readiness. Define planning and reporting standards, templates, RACI, reporting calendars, quality checks, and governance routines. Coach schedule owners and reporting contributors to improve planning maturity and data quality. Provide independent advice to senior stakeholders and escalate material schedule risks with practical recommendations. Key Deliverables Approved scheduling framework, coding structure, planning calendar, and schedule governance procedure. Integrated Primavera P6 master schedule with agreed baselines, interfaces, milestones, and critical path visibility. Power BI executive dashboard with documented definitions, refresh process, and reconciliation controls. Standard monthly and fortnightly PowerPoint reporting packs for executive governance forums. Critical path, milestone, two-week look-ahead, risk, dependency, change, and recovery reporting. Capability transfer materials and practical coaching for schedule owners and reporting contributors. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of relevant experience in planning and reporting. Proficiency in Primavera P6 for schedule establishment and control. Experience in designing and implementing Power BI data models and dashboards. Demonstrated ability to produce executive-level PowerPoint reports. Strong consulting mindset and ability to work effectively with both activity-level planners and executive decision-makers. Measures of Success Timely and consistent delivery of schedule performance, emerging risks, and required decisions to leadership. Clear ownership and traceable source data for all major milestones, dependencies, and critical paths. Reconciliation of Power BI and PowerPoint outputs with the approved Primavera P6 schedule. Reduction in manual effort and reporting cycle time through automation and standardization. Continuous improvement in schedule quality, update discipline, forecasting credibility, and stakeholder accountability.

90baee94ff3f1d6c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل عن كاتب مركز اتصالات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية التعامل مع طلبات واستفسارات العملاء عبر الهاتف، وتقديم معلومات حول المنتجات والخدمات، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير اليومية. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تلقي الطلبات الواردة عبر الهاتف والرد على استفسارات العملاء الأساسية، وتقديم معلومات تسويقية حول منتجات وخدمات المنشأة. إجراء المكالمات الصادرة لأغراض التسويق الهاتفي، والتعامل مع العملاء، وتقديم خدمات المنتجات، ومتابعة تحصيل الديون. تصعيد المكالمات التي تتطلب معلومات إضافية أو استجابات فنية إلى المستوى التالي لضمان تلبية احتياجات العملاء المعقدة. إعداد تقارير يومية مفصلة تتضمن أعداد المكالمات الإجمالية، والمكالمات التي تم الرد عليها، وجداول متابعة العملاء المحتملين، والعملاء الذين يحتاجون إلى معلومات أو خدمات إضافية. الالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات والإجراءات التنظيمية المعتمدة في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال مراكز الاتصال أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع المكالمات الواردة والصادرة بفعالية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة وقدرة على تقديم المعلومات بوضوح. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات خدمة العملاء والتواصل الفعال. القدرة على حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات الأساسية. مهارات تنظيمية وإعداد التقارير. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المحددة. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الفرصة في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، بنظام عمل دوام كامل. ستعمل ضمن فريق مركز الاتصال لتقديم الدعم للعملاء. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم.

907ade76a1a281a4.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث العالمية للخدمات البيئية عن كيميائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في حفر الباطن، المنطقة الشرقية. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية إجراء الأبحاث والتحاليل الكيميائية بهدف تطوير المنتجات والعمليات والتطبيقات. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الأبحاث والتجارب والتحاليل الكمية والنوعية للعناصر والمركبات العضوية واللاعضوية لتحديد خواصها الكيميائية وبنيتها وتفاعلاتها، مع دراسة وتحليل النتائج. تصميم وسائل وأساليب وتجهيزات، وتطوير المعادلات والعمليات والطرق لحل المشكلات الفنية والعملية. إجراء الأبحاث على المنتجات الكيميائية المصنعة بهدف تطوير وتحسين الإجراءات والعمليات وجودة المنتجات. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بنتائج الدراسات الفيزيائية وسبل تطويرها، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الكيمياء أو مجال ذي صلة. الحصول على شهادة ISO17025. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الفرصة بدوام كامل في مدينة حفر الباطن بالمنطقة الشرقية، ضمن فريق عمل متخصص في الخدمات البيئية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

90ba031735a760d5.description: نظرة عامة على الوظيفة تعلن مجموعة بن لادن السعودية عن حاجتها لـ مدير أشغال ومرافق عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق أنشطة إدارة المرافق في المنشأة، بالإضافة إلى تخطيط جداول أعمال الصيانة والتنظيف للمرافق الحالية والمستقبلية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع الخطط والسياسات والاستراتيجيات الإدارية العامة لمرافق الشركة، والإشراف على تنفيذها. ضمان الالتزام بقواعد ولوائح الصحة والسلامة والبيئة، والإشراف على تطبيقها. مباشرة الأنشطة اليومية للمرافق في المنشأة، بما في ذلك المواقع المادية والتصاميم. تخطيط الجداول الزمنية لأعمال الصيانة والتنظيف للمرافق. الإشراف على أنشطة الصيانة وتنسيق عمليات الإصلاح لتقليل مدة التوقف عن العمل. اختيار الموظفين وتدريبهم والإشراف عليهم، ومراقبة أدائهم وسلوكهم مقارنةً بالأهداف المحددة. تخطيط أعمال الإنشاء والملحقات الجديدة، وإعداد العقود المتعلقة بالبناء ومراجعتها والموافقة عليها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية لا تقل عن 10 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة بإدارة الأشغال والمرافق العامة. القدرة على تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق الأنشطة التشغيلية للمرافق. مهارات قيادية وإشرافية قوية لإدارة الفرق وتطوير الأداء. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب التفرغ التام للمهام والمسؤوليات الموكلة. موقع العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الدمام، بالمنطقة الشرقية. تقديم الطلبات لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة. يرجى من المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة تقديم طلباتهم.

90881e71e6c17b83.description: Job description Business Unit Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses. What the Role Entails Job Summary Tencent Cloud Middle East is looking for a Security Operations Specialist based in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The role supports the day-to-day operation of Tencent Cloud Middle East's cybersecurity activities: running established security processes, monitoring and triaging security events, maintaining compliance documentation, and coordinating with Tencent Cloud's central security and compliance teams. This is an individual-contributor role for a candidate in the early stage of their security career who wants to grow into cloud security operations and compliance. It does not carry people-management or strategy-ownership responsibilities. Job Responsibilities 1. Execute and maintain the security operations processes, procedures and checklists defined by Tencent Cloud's security and compliance teams; track tasks and tickets through to closure. 2. Monitor security alerts, vulnerabilities and risk items; perform initial triage, escalate to the appropriate owners, and keep risk and issue trackers accurate and up to date. 3. Support incident response activities under guidance — collect and preserve evidence, maintain incident timelines, coordinate with responders, and draft incident reports and post-incident summaries. 4. Assist with the periodic review and upkeep of cybersecurity and privacy policies, procedures, guidelines and compliance evidence, so that documentation stays current and audit-ready. 5. Prepare regular operational reports and dashboards on security posture, open risks, remediation progress and compliance status for internal stakeholders. 6. Support security awareness activities, internal communications, and the preparation of security documentation and questionnaire responses for customers and partners. Who We Look For 1. Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience. 2. 3–5 years of hands-on experience in security operations, IT operations, data security, privacy or compliance support; internships and graduate programmes count. 3. Working knowledge of common security operations tasks: alert monitoring, vulnerability management, access and entitlement review, log review, and incident documentation. 4. Familiarity with cloud services and common security technologies (for example IAM, network security controls, encryption, SIEM, endpoint protection); exposure to any major cloud platform is a plus. 5. Familiarity with information security and privacy standards and frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST CSF or PCI DSS; experience supporting audits or certification activities is a plus. 6. Basic awareness of information security and personal data protection requirements in Saudi Arabia (for example SAMA Cybersecurity Framework, PDPL, NCA controls) and a willingness to build deeper regulatory knowledge on the job. 7. Clear written and verbal communication in English; Arabic is a plus. 8. Detail-oriented, comfortable working with process, documentation and cross-team coordination. Entry-level certifications (Security+, CC, ISO 27001 Foundation) are a plus, not a requirement. Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
